Current route-boundary validator for the /v2/target-center continuation slice; proves the real target-management client is used and its legacy primary actions are remapped to /v2 routes without changing default legacy behavior.

Current source-contract guard for brand-scoped runtime persistence, shared V2 board readers, explicit append recovery, independent brand targets, max-five home series selection, and home time/comparison interactions; it does not replace browser, deployment, or owner acceptance gates.

Current source-contract guard for brand-summary and exactly-one-store series lenses, store contribution, target suppression at brand-series scope, truthful visitors/buyers and listing-level product identity; browser, deployment and owner acceptance remain separate gates.

Current route-mapping validator for the V2 continuation slice; proves board cross-page links use explicit /v2 mappings, missing management pages are blocked instead of leaking to legacy or 404, and the /v2/home empty-state CTA stays on /v2/upload.

Current route-boundary validator for /v2/search-assets and /v2/exclusion-rules; proves search assets bind the existing cross-page config contract, static mock tables are removed, exclusion rules stay explicitly BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_CONTRACT, and user-facing copy avoids developer-facing implementation jargon.

Current source-structure validator for V2 home metric settings; proves the default 17-metric grid remains intact, the v2 preference key isolates older stale sessions, and valid non-empty visible-metric subsets remain persistable instead of being forcibly reset.
